message.content:
This portrait-oriented editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover. At the top, the white word "TEMPO" is centered against a blue sky. Above it, on a dark horizontal band, yellow text reads "Investigasi: Kisruh Dana Yayasan BI". Below "TEMPO" is smaller text: "EDISI 29 September - 5 Oktober 2003".

The central image is an illustration of a man lying on the ground, shown from the chest up. He wears a tan uniform with blue and gold shoulder boards and a blue side cap with gold trim. His face is contorted in pain, with eyes squeezed shut and teeth bared. His right hand is clenched into a fist near his chin. Above him, a large black leather boot is positioned as if about to step on his head. The boot is attached to a leg wearing a tan trouser. 

In the center-left, large red text with black outlines reads "SIKSA DI JATINANGOR". At the bottom, a barcode sits on the left, "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN" is in the center, and "Rp 14.700" is on the right. The background behind the man is a pale, textured surface.
